description: Header file defining the ProgramNULL class, which implements ProgramImpl for a null renderer in the ANGLE project. It declares methods for shader program management, uniform setting, validation, linking, and path rendering parameters.
external_methods: LinkEvent (return type of load and link methods)

classes.name: ProgramNULL
classes.description: A null implementation of ProgramImpl used in the ANGLE renderer for the null backend, providing stub methods for shader program operations.

methods.name: ProgramNULL
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ProgramNULL object with a given ProgramState.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a program from a binary stream, returning a LinkEvent.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the program state to a binary stream.

methods.name: setBinaryRetrievableHint
methods.description: Sets whether the binary can be retrieved.

methods.name: setSeparable
methods.description: Sets whether the program is separable.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Links the program with given resources, returning a LinkEvent.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the program against device capabilities.

methods.name: setUniform*fv/iv/uiv
methods.description: Sets uniform variables of various types and sizes.

methods.name: setUniformMatrix*fv
methods.description: Sets uniform matrix variables of various sizes.

methods.name: setPathFragmentInputGen
methods.description: Sets parameters for fragment shader input variable interpolation for path rendering.
